name: dbt for Orca
description: A data catalog for the dbt project in your workspace: explore models by folder, tag, schema or owner, read their docs, columns and tests, select with dbt selectors, see visual lineage, run tests and track data quality (failing tests flagged on every node, with the rows they found), check a pull request's impact (changed models and everything downstream), and preview data through the project's own dbt (v1 dbt-core or v2 Fusion; Snowflake, ClickHouse, Postgres and any other adapter).

settings.title: dbt project folder
settings.description: Folder holding dbt_project.yml, relative to the workspace root. Leave empty to find it automatically.

settings.title: dbt command
settings.description: How to run dbt for data previews, and for parse and tests unless the command below is set. Leave empty to use the project's .venv/bin/dbt, else dbt on PATH (dbt-core v1 or dbt Fusion v2).

settings.title: Command for parse and tests
settings.description: Runs dbt parse and test runs, with dbt's arguments added at the end, such as a just recipe (just dbt). It runs in the dbt project folder without a terminal, so it must not ask questions. Leave empty to use the dbt command. Previews always use the dbt command: a wrapper can split their SQL apart.

settings.title: Base branch for Changes
settings.description: What Changes compares your branch with, usually the branch your pull request merges into. Leave empty for origin's default branch (else origin/main, origin/master, main or master).

settings.title: Env file
settings.description: The file queries read environment variables from, relative to the workspace root (or absolute). Leave empty to read every .env from the workspace root down to the dbt project. The panel's Environment dialog edits this file.

settings.title: Use dbt-core's v2 parser
settings.description: Parse with dbt-core's Rust v2 parser (dbt-core 1.12 and later) for previews, tests and parse. It reparses the whole project on every run and deletes target/partial_parse.msgpack, so your next dbt run in a terminal reparses in full. When it fails on the project, the run is repeated with dbt-core's own parser, which the project then keeps until Orca restarts.

settings.title: MCP server port
settings.description: Coding agents reach the project's lineage, impact analysis, tests and queries over MCP at http://127.0.0.1:<port>/mcp while the plugin is enabled. Only this computer can connect. Set 0 to turn the server off.
